items.title: Marty Morell interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 24, 2017
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You don’t have Johnny Hodges there anymore but if they’re still laying back as you say.

ctx.x: So, but he is just, for that kind of music he is just the best. He’s the easiest and it’s so easy to play with him, especially those Ellington style grooves. And it was a pleasure to work with him.

It’s interesting that the band has retained that – or retained that kind of feel with some of the key players having passed away or whatever. You don’t have Johnny Hodges there anymore but if they’re still laying back as you say.
